title: 第17章 路过第18章 初入季风
content_zh:
“不知道吉恩爵士领地是在哪个位置？”
菜还没开始上，现在桌子上只上了一些新大陆的时令水果，大家谈生意，人家也不会看你年轻就多给点钱～里克问道。
“是在季风镇，因为来的太过匆忙季风镇的资料都没有看过，只是知道前任领主是被自己的领民杀死的？”
吉恩表示自己不是很懂，但是又有点疑问？
“嗯，说起季风镇那里可是个好地方，它是三河汇聚之地，它建立在风之湖旁边，由黑水河及艾克西河汇流成了风之湖，再由里恩河可以直接到希望之城，不过因为那里地处偏远，当地居民时常需要抵御艾克西沼泽及黑山山脉跑出来的兽潮！
所以季风镇那里的民风彪悍，不过也因为背靠黑山黑山脉，及艾克西大沼泽所以季风镇是格林帝国在新大陆的魔丹魔兽皮毛的重要资源地之一，每年还有一部分运到天启大陆出售！
最重要的是季风镇的风之湖里面每年能产出一定量的风属性的风之息，听说可以用来给法阵充能，还可以给风系魔兽进阶，虽然功能不多但是都是某些配方里面必须的！
就是有一个问题，因为民风彪悍如果领主实力不够强后台不够硬，一般人是统治不了季风镇的，希望之城里的大人大家族物互相拖后腿，导致季风到现在已经换了三任领主了，可惜都过不了一年～我听说如果帝国再不安排领主过来接手，希望之城明年就会安排贵族理事会轮流派驻季风镇了。”
里克将季风镇的情况大致的说了下。
“那不是很好玩！”
米莉还怕过来就是种地，一听季风镇那里不仅民风彪悍，而且还日常有兽潮出没不由得来了兴致！
你想能在兽潮底下生存的聚集地能没有两把刷子吗？
“当然了对于实力强大的吉恩爵士你们上任应该是没有任何问题，毕竟你们两位可是能单挑一艘海盗船的强者，不过明枪易躲暗箭难防，还是需要谨慎点的。”
里克笑道，里克的意思是季风镇对于普通的领主前去管理，肯定是困难重重，但是如果你有实力那就不一样了～你想普通民众再强又能强到哪里去？还不是以命抵命罢了！
真正有能力有本事的早就逃离了季风镇去已经开发成熟的城市生活了。
不过有势力的家族一般也不会去接收那个偏远地区的领地，所以季风镇就是高不成低不就～虽有资源但是没有领主当家做主也卖不起价格，全年都只能在温饱线上徘徊。
“嗯，里克老板说的在理，还有一事我看你们船厂里面也需要用到大量的铁料，我们想采购一批铁料不知道有没有合适的铁厂？”
吉恩点了点头，然后问了下里克这个当地人，刚刚在现场他见到船厂里面也有许多各种作用的铁料，所以想问一下节约时间。
里克听完后表示没有问题，他还可以带吉恩他们过去，他船厂采购的是强度不算最高但是韧性需求最强的铁料，一吨五百金币！
如果质量一样可以按照这个价格拿货，吉恩说等到了看了质量再说价格，然后又从里克这里了解了下希望之城（后面都称希望之城了）最强的领主，可以说整个格林帝国在新大陆的势力里面就数瑞安.伊维里欧斯王爵了最强了。

他是格林帝国皇族的一个分支，按照辈分他应该同现今在任的格林帝国皇帝奥杜温.伊维里欧斯，是堂兄弟关系，瑞安王爵继承了父亲的爵位，是格林帝国在新大陆的王！
希望之城最初就是他们家掏钱建设的，然后在外围还有他们家族的领地，然后下面还有四个公爵五个侯爵，伯爵子爵男爵就不说了，因为防御收缩及格林帝国减少新大陆的投入很多失去领地的贵族都龟缩在希望之城里面靠着祖辈的积蓄醉生梦死，他们也不想回天启大陆，当年被派到新大陆的本来就不是各大家族的嫡子长孙，所以他们对于天启大陆也没有太大的归属感，再说了这些贵族哪怕再落魄在希望之城这个常驻人口七八十万的大城市里面还是有些资产的！
然后吉恩问了下这边的职业者学院情况，里克叹了口气说只有一所中级职业学院及高级学院但是没有几个老师，真正有天赋的还是会被家族送到天启大陆那边去学习，最后一般是不会回来了，虽然这几年瑞安王爵都是致力在寻找优秀的职业者，想为希望之城的职业者学院添砖加瓦，但是还是杯水车薪，希望之城留不住人才啊～
这让吉恩与米莉也松了口气，米莉是想着没有人教自己就可以放弃剑士职业了，全心投入到修真上去，本来因为心里没底，不知道该不该放弃剑士职业，现在被动放弃了也好！
吉恩也差不多，毕竟魔法也花了他不少功夫，直接丢了又觉得可惜了？不过好在贵族头衔可以让他有空可以来希望之城图书馆免费看书～可以用ai复制这里面的资料！
content_en:
"I wonder where Sir Jean's territory is?"
The food hasn't started yet, and now there are only some seasonal fruits from the New World on the table. We are talking about business, and people won't give you more money just because you are young~ Rick asked.
"It's in Monsoon Town. Because I came in such a hurry, I haven't read the information about Monsoon Town. I just know that the previous lord was killed by his own subjects?"
Jean said he didn't understand very well, but he had some questions?
"Well, speaking of Monsoon Town, it is a good place. It is the place where three rivers converge. It is built next to the Lake of Winds. The Blackwater River and the Aixi River merge to form the Lake of Winds. From there, you can go directly to the City of Hope from the Lean River. However, because of its remote location, local residents often need to resist the tide of beasts coming out of the Aixi Swamp and the Black Mountain Mountains!
Therefore, the folk customs in Monsoon Town are fierce, but also because it is backed by the Black Mountains and the Exi Swamp, Monsoon Town is one of the important resources for the Green Empire's magic pills and monster furs in the New World. Every year, some of them are shipped to Apocalypse Continent for sale!
The most important thing is that the Wind Lake in Monsoon Town can produce a certain amount of wind-attribute breath of wind every year. I heard that it can be used to charge magic circles and advance wind-type monsters. Although it has not many functions, it is necessary in certain formulas!
There is a problem, because the folk customs are strong and if the lord is not strong enough and the backing is not strong enough, ordinary people cannot rule Monsoon Town. The adults and big families in the City of Hope hold each other back, causing Monsoon to have changed three lords so far. Unfortunately, it will not last more than a year~ I heard that if the empire does not arrange for a lord to take over, the City of Hope will arrange for the Council of Nobles to take turns stationed in Monsoon Town next year. "
Rick gave a general overview of the situation in Monsoon Town.
"That's not fun!"
Milly was also afraid that coming here would involve farming. She became interested when she heard that not only were the folk customs in Monsoon Town strong, but there were also beasts that appeared every day!
Do you think a gathering place that can survive under the beast tide can be without two brushes?
"Of course, there shouldn't be any problem with the powerful Sir Jean taking office. After all, you two are strong men who can fight a pirate ship alone. However, you still need to be cautious."
Rick smiled and said, what Rick means is that Monsoon Town must be very difficult for ordinary lords to manage, but if you have the strength, it will be different. How strong do you think ordinary people can be, no matter how strong they are? It’s not just a life for a life!
Those who are truly capable and capable have long since fled Monsoon Town to live in already developed cities.
However, powerful families generally would not take over the territory in that remote area, so Monsoon Town was struggling to make ends meet. Although it had resources, it could not afford the price without a lord in charge, so it could only live on the subsistence line all year round.
"Well, what Boss Rick said makes sense. One more thing, I think your shipyard also needs a lot of iron. We want to purchase a batch of iron. Is there a suitable iron factory?"
Gene nodded, and then asked Rick, a local. He had just seen at the scene that there were many iron materials with various functions in the shipyard, so he wanted to ask about saving time.
After hearing this, Rick said that there was no problem. He could also take Jean and the others there. The iron material his shipyard purchased was not the strongest but required the strongest toughness, costing 500 gold coins per ton!
If the quality is the same, the product can be purchased at this price. Gene said that he would wait until he sees the quality before talking about the price. Then he learned from Rick about the strongest lord in the City of Hope (hereinafter referred to as the City of Hope). It can be said that the entire Green Empire is the strongest among the forces in the New World. Lord Ryan Ivelrios.
He is a branch of the royal family of the Green Empire. According to his seniority, he should be a cousin of the current Emperor of the Green Empire, Alduin Ivelrios.Relationship, Prince Ruian inherited his father's title and became the king of the Green Empire in the New World!
The City of Hope was originally built with money from their family, and then there was their family's territory on the periphery, and then there were four dukes and five marquises, not to mention the earls, viscounts, and barons. Because of the contraction of defense and the Green Empire's reduction in investment in the New World, many nobles who had lost their territories were hunkering down in the City of Hope, relying on their ancestors' savings. Even if they are drunk and dreaming, they don’t want to return to the Apocalypse Continent. The people who were sent to the New Continent were not the legitimate sons and eldest grandsons of the major families, so they don’t have much sense of belonging to the Apocalypse Continent. Besides, no matter how destitute these nobles are, they still have some assets in the City of Hope, a big city with a permanent population of 700,000 or 800,000!
Then Gene asked about the situation of the professional college here. Rick sighed and said that there is only one intermediate vocational college and an advanced college but there are not many teachers. The truly talented ones will be sent to Tianqi Continent by their families to study. In the end, they usually will not come back. Although Prince Ruian has been committed to looking for outstanding professionals in the past few years and wants to contribute to the professional college in the City of Hope, it is still a drop in the bucket. The City of Hope cannot retain talents~
This made Jean and Milly breathe a sigh of relief. Milly thought that she could give up the swordsman profession without anyone to teach her, and devote herself to cultivation. Originally, she didn't know if she should give up the swordsman profession because she was unsure, so now she just gave up passively!
The same goes for Jean. After all, magic also took a lot of effort from him. Wouldn't it be a pity to just throw it away? But fortunately, the noble title allows him to come to the City of Hope Library to read books for free when he is free - and he can use AI to copy the materials there!
